description: Sends something in a deal's chat, to the other side: a message, a proposed pickup time, accepting the other side's proposed time, or (the seller only) the pickup address. Send only what the person asked you to, in their words. Payment only goes through agentPickup: messages asking for another payment, and links, aren't sent. The other side sees it in their chat and gets an email if they don't read it soon. Needs sign-in.

accept_pickup.description: Accept the pickup time the other side proposed.

as.description: Only when the person is both buyer and seller (a test): which side to act as.

pickup_address.description: The seller only: the address to pick up from.

propose_pickup_at.description: A pickup time to propose: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM" on the local clock where the item is picked up.

text.description: The message, in the person's words.

name: message_deal
title: Send a message in a deal's chat
